• Minimum of 5+ years full sales cycle/closing experience with existing business accounts

• Ability to understand technical requirements and craft solutions across multiple technology  products

• Strong operational acumen and ability to manage and prioritize a book of 100 accounts

• Ability and motivation to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment

• Superior verbal and written communication skills

Preferred qualifications

• Prior experience in a sales and/or customer-facing role at a high growth payments company

title: Mail Clerk (Southfield, MI)
description:

About the Role:

We're looking for a dependable and detail-oriented team member to join our office operations as a Mail Room Clerk. In this role, you'll play a critical part in managing the flow of physical documents through printing, filing, and mail distribution. You'll ensure all materials are organized, accurately handled, and delivered to the right place at the right time. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys routine, takes pride in precision, and understands the importance of supporting the broader team behind the scenes. If you’re proactive, organized, and enjoy working in a supportive role, we’d love to meet you.

What You'll Do:

• Communication Skills: Able to follow instructions and communicate clearly with coworkers.

• Technical Proficiency: Comfortable using basic office equipment like Mac computers, Google Suite, printers, copiers, and filing systems.

• Reliable Transportation: Must have access to transportation to complete regular errands such as trips to the post office, shipping centers, or local vendors.

• Team Player: Willingness to pitch in wherever needed to support the team where needed

In the agentic era, threats and vulnerabilities occur at machine speed and scale and we are building a platform to detect and respond to these threats in real time. - Clear communication and comfort collaborating with cross-functional partners

- BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

- Exposure to cloud-native security controls (e.g., VPC Service Controls, Private Link)

- Experience with egress control, network perimeter enforcement, or policy engines

- Familiarity with AI-assisted development workflows and tooling

title: Senior Programme Officer - Transport (Africa)
description:
Background
The African Climate Foundation (ACF) is the first and only African-led climate change re-granting organisation on the continent. Through a combination of grant making, fellowships, transformational research, technical assistance, coalition building and advocacy the ACF seeks to support interventions at the nexus of climate change, and development that have the greatest potential to deliver long-term socio-economic transformation and inclusive development. ACF also provides Fiscal Hosting (also called Fiscal Sponsorship) services to support emerging and mission aligned organisations and initiatives.
About the Transport Programme
The ACF Transport Programme supports an African-led transition to clean, safe, affordable and accessible transport. It works on the policy, finance and public support needed to move people and goods more sustainably, and treats electric mobility as one part of a wider shift that also covers public and popular transport such as buses and minibus taxis. Working with governments, financial institutions, civil society, research partners and the private sector, the programme combines grant-making, technical assistance, research, convening and advocacy. It also collaborates with partners and global initiatives, so that African priorities shape how transport systems are planned and financed.
Purpose
Reporting to Transport Programme Manager, the Senior Programme Officer will play a pivotal role in implementing the Transport Programme’s Africa strategy, supporting the Programme Manager to deliver a continent-wide mobility transition. The role is suited for someone with a deep understanding of Africa’s transport and energy landscape, strong project management skills, and a passion for accelerating climate and industrial transformation.

• Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with government agencies, civil society partners, multilateral institutions, and technical collaborators.

Rural Partners Corps (RPC) is a new AmeriCorps service fellowship from Lead For America (LFA) that places locally rooted Members with rural, place-based backbone organizations.
Members already live in or near the communities they serve. They bring local knowledge, transferable skills, relationships, and a commitment to making their communities stronger.
RPC Members serve 40 hours per week from December through August, working alongside Host Site staff and community partners to build organizational and community capacity and advance cradle-to-career economic mobility for rural young people.
Who Should Apply?
RPC Host Sites are place-based backbone organizations serving rural communities or regions. Eligible entities include:

• Regional or community-based nonprofits

• Community Development Corporations (CDCs) & Economic Development Organizations (EDOs)

• Cradle-to-career partnerships & collective impact initiatives

• Community foundations & philanthropic organizations

• Tribal governments & Native-led organizations

• Local government agencies & regional councils of government

• Education organizations (K12 through Higher Education Institutions)

What Does Your Organization Gain?
Dedicated Capacity: A full-time Member focused on meaningful projects that advance your organization's priorities.
Stronger Partnerships: Additional capacity to build relationships, convene partners, and connect community assets.
Organizational Infrastructure: Tools, systems, research, processes, volunteer infrastructure, and other resources that strengthen your organization's capacity.
Local Talent: A motivated community member who already knows and cares about the place-and wants to contribute to its future.
LFA Support: Your Member receives ongoing coaching and professional development through LFA, while your organization has a dedicated LFA Program Coordinator as an additional source of support.

An RPC Member joins your organization as a locally rooted capacity-building partner.
They are not an intern, temporary worker, outside consultant, or replacement for existing staff. Instead, they bring their skills, relationships, local knowledge, and initiative to help your organization move important community priorities forward.

1. Know the Place

• Conduct community asset mapping and listening

• Learn the community's strengths, priorities, relationships, and existing initiatives

• Engage community stakeholders and partners

• Support cross-sector collaboration and community convenings

• Connect people, organizations, and resources

• Support strategic planning and implementation

• Develop tools, processes, resources, and systems

• Support training, workshops, outreach, and community engagement

5. Support Cradle-to-Career & Economic Mobility

• Contribute to initiatives involving youth, education, workforce development, career pathways, and economic mobility

• Help strengthen connections across schools, nonprofits, employers, government, higher education, and other community partners

The Member's approach is: Know the Place → Build Relationships → Understand Priorities → Organize → Connect → Execute → Build Capacity

title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine – Data Infrastructure
description:
The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness.

In this role, you'll build the knowledge construction pipelines: turning everything from a 100k docs/s web crawl to vendor datasets into a graph of what is true about the world, and keeping it correct as data changes.

This is greenfield work with a massive scope. There is no off-the-shelf system for building a model of the world from the open web, so you'll make foundational decisions, from how claims are represented and resolved to how trust is assigned and how the graph evolves over time, that everything built on top of it depends on.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Continuously synthesize the live web crawl, vendor deliveries and APIs, and other off-the-web sources into one typed graph: extraction that turns pages and records into ontology-shaped claims, each carrying its provenance, timestamp and confidence.

- Bring every new source in cleanly: versioned, append-only history with schema evolution, late-arriving and corrected records, and replayable cursors, so every claim traces back to the exact delivery that produced it.

- Decide what to trust: entity resolution across billions of records (blocking, pairwise scoring, clustering) into canonical people, companies, places and publications, then truth discovery that weighs source reliability, recency and corroboration to reconcile conflicting claims.

- Keep that picture current and convergent: streams arrive continuously, out of order and at very different rates, so the graph is eventually consistent by design. You'll build incremental computation over change data feeds, where each update is a diff of what changed and every job is idempotent and resumable, so the graph converges to the same state however runs interleave, fail or replay, and readers only ever see committed, consistent versions.

- Measure precision and completeness: labeled evals for extraction and resolution, per-source coverage and correctness metrics, and lineage that pinpoints which source or stage broke and why.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- You've built and operated large-scale distributed data pipelines in production over petabytes of structured and unstructured data, with Spark over a lakehouse format (Delta Lake, Iceberg, Hudi).

- You understand incremental processing deeply: change data capture, idempotent writes, backfills and reprocessing.

- Strong in Python and at least one systems language; you can read and tune Spark query plans.

- You obsess over correctness, reliability and data quality as much as scale.

BONUS

- Entity resolution, record linkage, knowledge graphs or ontologies

- Information extraction or truth discovery at scale

- Lance or other columnar/vector-native formats

EXAMPLE PROJECTS

- Take a new billion-row dataset from first delivery to queryable entities in days, not months.

- Keep a graph of hundreds of billions of claims current with incremental updates, so a fact that changes on the web reaches it in minutes.

- Build a system that knows every company and person in the world, with one evidence-backed record each, resolved across the web and every source we ingest.

Description
We are seeking an experienced Bilingual Customer Support Specialist fluent in English and French-Canadian to join a customer support team handling general customer inquiries, product questions, and warranty claims.
This is a fully remote opportunity for candidates currently residing in Canada who are confident communicating professionally and naturally in both English and French.
Authentic Quebecois French is strongly preferred. Candidates should be comfortable with the Quebecois dialect, including regional expressions, conversational language, and commonly used Quebec slang. The ability to communicate naturally with French-speaking customers in Quebec is particularly important.
The ideal candidate is personable, articulate, customer-focused, and experienced in providing support across phone, email, and live chat.
Key Responsibilities

• Handle customer inquiries through inbound phone calls, email, and live chat in both English and French.

• Assist customers with warranty claims, product-related questions, and general support requests.

• Communicate clearly, professionally, and empathetically with customers in both languages.

• Understand customer concerns, identify appropriate solutions, and escalate issues when necessary.

• Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and case updates.

• Manage multiple customer inquiries while maintaining service quality and response standards.

Compensation

• $14 CAD per hour

• Paid weekly in arrears

• Independent contract

• Full-time, fully remote opportunity

• Paid training

Technical Requirements (Essential)
Candidates must have their own computer and meet the following minimum technical requirements:

• Windows 11 PC (Mac not supported)

• Minimum 16 GB RAM

• Dual monitors

• Webcam and headset

• Intel i5 processor or higher

• High-speed internet with a wired Ethernet connection

• Backup power solution

• Microsoft Teams / Office 365

Applications that do not meet the minimum technical requirements will not move forward in the process.
Hiring Process
Our hiring process includes multiple stages to ensure the right fit for both the role and the client environment.
The process includes:

• English Resume Review

• Pre-Screen Questionnaire

• One-Way Video Interview

• Pre-Screen Interview

• Live Interviews

Important Information

• Candidates must complete both the pre-screen questionnaire and one-way video interview to be considered.

• All resumes must be submitted in English.

• Live interviews will be conducted via Microsoft Teams using a laptop or desktop computer.

• Only candidates currently residing in Canada will be considered.

Requirements
Requirements

• Must currently reside in Canada.

• Native or near-native fluency in both English and French-Canadian.

• Strong preference for candidates with an authentic Quebecois accent and familiarity with Quebecois expressions and slang.

• Previous customer service or customer support experience is required.

• Experience handling customer interactions across phone, email, and live chat.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both languages.

• Strong listening, problem-solving, and interpersonal skills.

• Ability to manage multiple customer interactions and work independently in a remote environment.

• A reliable internet connection and a professional remote working environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience handling warranty claims, product support, or after-sales customer service.

• Previous call center or contact center experience.

• Experience working with North American customers, particularly those based in Quebec.

• Familiarity with CRM platforms, ticketing systems, and customer support software.

Job Description
Job Title: Data Partnerships Manager
Job Type: Full-time
Location: Remote

The Role
We are looking for a Data Partnerships Manager to identify, engage, and close partnerships with companies interested in contributing workflow data for AI training and evaluation.
You will own the partnership process end-to-end: sourcing companies, running discovery conversations, understanding business workflows, navigating privacy and security discussions, negotiating commercial terms, and onboarding new partners.

• Negotiate commercial terms and close partnership agreements.

• Build and manage a pipeline of high-quality partnership opportunities.

• Collaborate with internal operations, product, and data teams to successfully onboard new partners.

• Help develop repeatable acquisition strategies, messaging, and partnership playbooks as the program scales.

• 3+ years of experience in Business Development, Partnerships, Enterprise Sales, Strategic Partnerships, or a similar customer-facing role.

• Demonstrated success sourcing, negotiating, and closing B2B partnerships or complex commercial deals.

• Strong communication skills and ability to build credibility with senior decision-makers.

• Comfortable discussing sensitive topics including privacy, security, confidentiality, and data ownership.

• Ability to explain technical concepts in a clear and compelling way to non-technical audiences.

• Strong discovery, qualification, and consultative selling skills.

• Experience with outbound prospecting and pipeline development.

• Proficiency with tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, HubSpot or similar platforms.

• Highly resourceful, execution-oriented, and comfortable operating in fast-moving environments.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in AI, data, SaaS, marketplaces, or technology partnerships.

• Experience working with SMBs, founders, and owner-operated businesses.

• Familiarity with data licensing, data acquisition, or emerging AI infrastructure markets.
